description: A newly created PostgreSQL 17 Alpine container replayed the complete production migration chain and executed the locked three-Realm credential, asset, transition and 48-negative E04 matrix.
isolation: Disposable Docker container zhudatuan-e04-fdec2a7792ec43c5; synthetic E04 identities, Sessions and orders only; every negative write was savepoint-rolled back and the container was removed after execution.
production_impact: None. No production service, database, domain, payment provider, deployment channel or customer record was contacted.
differences_from_production: Local disposable Docker PostgreSQL rather than managed Alibaba Cloud PostgreSQL.
Synthetic Realm, identity, Session and order fixtures rather than customer traffic.

Credential lookup and node-bound authorization executed production source; Session rows and the final order read/write adapter were driven directly by the evidence workload rather than public HTTP ingress.
No stable separately managed staging execution and no production observation.

runtime.postgres: PostgreSQL 17.11 on aarch64-unknown-linux-musl, compiled by gcc (Alpine 15.2.0) 15.2.0, 64-bit
